mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LA_CONFIGS WHERE PROPERTY_KEY = #{key} AND APPLICATION = #{application})

SELECT T1.PROPERTY_ID, T1.PROPERTY_NAME, T1.PROPERTY_KEY, T1.PROPERTY_VALUE, T1.PROPERTY_TYPE, T1.PROPERTY_DESC, T1.APPLICATION,T2.OPTION_ID, T2.OPTION_NAME, T2.OPTION_VALUE, T2.OPTION_DESC FROM LA_CONFIGS T1 LEFT JOIN LA_CONFIG_OPTIONS T2 ON T1.PROPERTY_ID = T2.PROPERTY_ID AND T1.APPLICATION = T2.APPLICATION WHERE T1.PROPERTY_ID = #{id}
